hook: My bank cut a charge I **never agreed to.**

slides.title: Step one: **your bank.**
slides.body: You must first complain to the bank itself. The RBI Ombudsman comes in only after the bank has had its chance to reply.

slides.title: The **new RBI Ombudsman** scheme.
slides.body: The Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026 is in force from 1 July 2026. It handles complaints of deficiency in service by banks and other entities it covers.

timeline.text: No reply, or you're not satisfied with it

slides.title: How to **file.**
list: Post: signed complaint form to CRPC, RBI, Central Vista, Sector 17, Chandigarh 160017
slides.ref: RB-IOS 2026 · RBI FAQ Q9, Q10, Q11

slides.title: It's **free.**
slides.body: There is no charge or fee for filing or resolving complaints. You don't need any third-party agency.

slides.title: What the Ombudsman **can award.**
list: Up to Rs 30 lakh for consequential loss
Up to Rs 3 lakh for lost time, expenses and harassment
Unhappy with the award? Appeal within 30 days
slides.ref: RB-IOS 2026 · RBI FAQ Q22, Q23, Q31, Q32

sources: Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026 (in force from 1 July 2026)
Reserve Bank of India – FAQs on RB-IOS 2026 (rbi.org.in); Press Release 2025-2026/1936, 16 Jan 2026
caption:
Your bank charged you for something you didn't agree to? Here's where to complain. 👇

1️⃣ First, complain to your bank
2️⃣ No reply in 30 days, or not satisfied? Go to the RBI Ombudsman
3️⃣ File within 90 days after that, on cms.rbi.org.in or at crpc@rbi.org.in
4️⃣ It's free. There is no fee to file or resolve a complaint
5️⃣ The Ombudsman can award up to Rs 30 lakh for consequential loss, plus up to Rs 3 lakh for time, expenses and harassment
6️⃣ The new RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026 is in force from 1 July 2026

Source: Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026; RBI FAQs
